items.text:
This is what I would’ve done if I were starting from scratch today as a busy mom who wanted to build an online business. 👇

If I only had $1,000 in my bank account and wanted to build an additional income stream, here’s the simple plan I’d follow:

1️⃣ Start a brand-new social media account 📱
Fresh page. Fresh mindset.
Don’t worry about what everyone else thinks.
Focus on serving people, not impressing them.

2️⃣ Post 5–7 second reels 🎥
Simple B-roll clips.
Text on the screen.
No talking if you don’t want to.
No showing your face if you prefer to stay faceless.
Consistency beats perfection.

3️⃣ Choose ONE affiliate offer to promote 💻
Don’t overwhelm yourself with dozens of products.
Learn one system, master it, then scale.
The simpler your offer, the easier it is to explain.

4️⃣ Use ONE link in your bio 🔗
One clear destination.
One simple next step.
Don’t confuse your audience with too many choices.

5️⃣ Let your system do the work 🚀
Share valuable content.
Send people to your link.
No spending all day in your DMs.

Why this works:

✅ Beginner-friendly
✅ No huge following required
✅ Can be done in pockets of time
✅ Simple strategy you can repeat
